name: adds-test-and-verifies
why: A real task: Claude adds a test, follows 'Verifying your work', and leaves the suite green.
prompt: In packages/shared/src/schemas.test.ts add a test that modeSchema rejects the lowercase value "build". Do not change any other file. Verify your work as CLAUDE.md requires.
check: git diff --name-only | grep -qx 'packages/shared/src/schemas.test.ts' && [ "$(git diff --name-only | wc -l)" -eq 1 ] && grep -q '"build"' packages/shared/src/schemas.test.ts && bun test packages/shared
